notes.title: Patch Notes BMA BETA V1.03
notes.content:
[b]Bunny Madness Anarchy[/b]

[b]Patch Notes BETA V1.03[/b]

-Fixed explosions for all characters for better gameplay.
-Bug fixes for Supply Run mode were implemented.
-Magnus equipment changed from a flash grenade to a shield.
-Added regions to lobby creation.
- Blood indicator now only appears when health is low.
-All skins now appear greyed out in menu until unlocked.
-Added health and shield bars to the UI.
-Recoil from hip different from recoil while aiming.
-Character animation improvements
-Character balancing 
-General tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes BMA BETA V1.02
notes.content:
[b]Bunny Madness Anarchy[/b]

[b]Patch Notes BETA V1.02[/b]

-Added kick functionality to the host in the game lobby.
-Host can now see who is not ready in the game lobby.
-Added Health Warning disclaimer screen.
-Fixed issue with characters not sprinting with the gamepad.
-Added indicator to ammo pickup and changed its mesh.
-Malice's sonar antenna is now visual on clients.
-Fixed issue where graphics settings were defaulting when starting a match.
-Ramree's Stun Grenade now completely stuns the enemy.
-Cooldown countdown text has been added for clarity.
-Sound notifier has been added when equipment is ready to be used.
-Equipment animation now takes priority over shooting (can't cancel).
-Directional hit markers have been added.
-Fixed issue with recoils not working.
-Added position marker for allies.
-Added position marker that shows where an ally was killed.
-Fixed issue where mapping gamepad controls to keyboard would cause the game to crash.
-Character animation improvements.
-General character balancing.
-General tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes BMA BETA V1.01
notes.content:
[b]Bunny Madness Anarchy[/b]

[b]Patch Notes BETA V1.01[/b]

-Equipment has been changed from a quantity system to a cool down system.
-Reticle textures have been remade to look smooth.
-Reticles now change to blue when aiming at allies.
-Hit markers now appear on the reticle whenever an enemy is being hit.
-Kills with head shots now cause the head to explode.
-Alan's grenade has been changed to a grenade launcher.
-Kill feed now shows cause of death.
-Melee system has been upgraded.
-User Interface in Host Menu has been improved to clarify what game mode is being chosen.
-User interface in Supply Run Mode has been changed to provide clarity.
-Volume changes now apply to lobby.
-Character animations have been improved.
-General tweaks and fixes.
